verdicts.claim: Nothing changes: the app already follows the 2026 Hellfire Dispatches printing (rank 6, heightening from 14th to a maximum of 10th); WG's older Character Guide numbers are a deliberate difference that must be written down.
Nothing changes: the app already carries the current one-action Strike that lowers nearby allies' frightened value; WG's superseded save-upgrade printing is a deliberate difference.

Nothing changes: the app carries the Player Core text only; WG's extra Acrobatics-for-Reflex substitution on Grab an Edge is the Core Rulebook clause Player Core deliberately dropped and must not be added.
The dedication's 4 pyrotechnic versatile vials are a bare counter with no item behind them, so the player has nothing to throw; a real pyrotechnic versatile vial item must exist.
The record's book link still points at the superseded 2021 printing even though its displayed text is already the current one.
Nothing changes: the dedication grants mental resistance and the Intimidation step only; WG's armour training belongs to Armiger's Protection, which the app already builds.
The +2 Crafting situational star comes from the superseded 2021 printing and must be deleted; the current entry prints no +2.
Nothing changes: the app matches the Hellfire Dispatches reprint word for word; WG's Character Guide text is a deliberate difference.

Nothing changes: this 2019 World Guide feat belongs to a Red Mantis archetype the 2024 book replaced whole, so it grants nothing on the new archetype; WG's legacy slot grant is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the app keeps the Lost Omens Ancestry Guide printing (Rare, Androffan + Common); WG's Starfinder Player Core printing is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the app asks dragon or leech and grants the matching deviant feat; WG's flat Consume Energy grant is the older wording and is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the app asks flicker or wraith and grants the matching deviant feat; WG's flat Eerie Flicker grant is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the app asks leech or wraith and grants the matching deviant feat; WG's flat Ghostly Grasp grant is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the app asks flicker or troll per the newer printing; WG's troll-only text and data are a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: Bestial Clarity triggers on an enchantment effect exactly as printed; WG's wider 'mental effect' trigger must not be copied.
Nothing changes: the app asks dragon or troll and grants that branch; WG's troll-only Bone Spikes text is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the feat keeps print's necromancy wording; WG's death/void trait trigger is a deliberate difference.
The magus must move whole to the 2026 Impossible Magic printing, whose Spells per Day table keeps 2 slots at every unlocked rank instead of emptying the lower ranks.
The summoner must move whole to the 2026 Impossible Magic printing, whose Spells per Day table keeps 2 slots at every unlocked rank instead of only the two highest.
Basic Magus Spellcasting is a Feat 4 granting the ordinary basic spellcasting benefits in the 2026 printing, not a Feat 6 granting the bounded ones.
Expert Magus Spellcasting grants the expert spellcasting benefits (not the bounded ones) and requires master in Arcana in the 2026 printing.
Master Magus Spellcasting grants the master spellcasting benefits (not the bounded ones) and requires legendary in Arcana in the 2026 printing.
Basic Summoner Spellcasting is a Feat 4 granting the ordinary basic spellcasting benefits in the 2026 printing, not a Feat 6 granting the bounded ones.
Expert Summoner Spellcasting grants the expert spellcasting benefits (not the bounded ones) and requires master in the skill associated with the eidolon's tradition.
Master Summoner Spellcasting grants the master spellcasting benefits (not the bounded ones) and requires legendary in the skill associated with the eidolon's tradition.

Studious Spells must be rebuilt as the 2026 'Studious Spell': a level-7 list of named spells added to the spellbook with a free-action Arcane Cascade rider, not a grant of extra restricted spell slots.
Nothing changes: the app's apparition/animist slot levels match the printed table row for row; WG is one level late on the 7th, 8th and 9th ranks.
Nothing changes: the animist class slot table matches print at every level and rank; WG's single 7th-rank slot at levels 13-18 is a deliberate difference.

Nothing changes: the innate spell is trained and becomes expert at 12th by the general rule, and the single tradition-narrowed picker stays; WG's four tradition-gated pickers and level-4 expert condition are a deliberate difference.

Nothing changes: Spore Order already counts as a member of the Leaf Order for the ten feats that ask for it, and blocking stays off (option B, know the membership and block nothing); WG's whole-Leaf-Order grant is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: Cultivation Order already counts as a member of the Leaf Order and blocking stays off; WG's empty Leaf Order record is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: Divine Breadth grants extra slots only, no cantrip; WG's extra cantrip entry is a copied slip and a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: Primal Breadth grants extra slots only, no cantrip; WG's copied cantrip entry is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: Occult Breadth grants extra slots only, no cantrip - the same ruling the owner gave for Divine and Primal Breadth; WG's copied cantrip entry is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the background stays common because the printed entry carries no rarity trait; WG's uncommon rating is a deliberate difference.
The Survival-or-Performance choice is asked twice and the two controls can be answered differently, training two skills instead of one; it must be asked once.
Nothing changes on rarity: the background stays common; WG's uncommon rating is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the background stays common; WG's uncommon rating is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the background stays common; WG's uncommon rating is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the background stays common; WG's uncommon rating is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: Sky Rider trains Acrobatics AND Plane of Air Lore, not one or the other; WG's pick is a deliberate difference.
The Crafting-or-Society choice is correct and stays, but the record's description text must be the printed sentence from the current Tian Xia Character Guide page rather than our rewrite.
The heightening to rank 5 at level 14 is a note that nothing reads; it must fire only for Order of the Gate members, read from the order the player already recorded.

Nothing changes: the app carries the printed split (master for simple and martial firearms and crossbows, expert for advanced) plus the critical specialization; WG's blanket master and missing crit spec are a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: critical specialization while raging is melee weapons and unarmed attacks only; WG's whole-category grant is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the feat trains Shoony Lore and nothing else; WG's Additional Lore grant adds three skill increases this feat never prints.

Nothing changes: the picker offers the printed union of the occult and primal cantrip lists, with the answer only setting the innate tradition; WG's tradition-first narrowing is a deliberate difference.
The repertoire picker offers all 38 occult cantrips; print names exactly four, so the picker must be restricted to them.
Nothing changes: 'instead of the normal attribute boosts and flaws' replaces the whole set, free boost included; WG's three-boost reading is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the save upgrade fires only against traps that feature magical writing; WG's any-magical-trap trigger is a deliberate difference.
The resonant sentence is only in the item's description; it must also print on the augury spell entry the stone grants.
The resonant 10-damage sentence is only in the item's description; it must also print on the shield spell entry the stone grants.
This one stone carries both the wayfinder mark and an older yes/no picker asking the same question; the duplicate picker must go.
The resonant sentence is only in the item's description; it must also print on the illusory disguise entry the stone grants.

The printed spell name was rewritten at import from Dancing Lights to Light, which is wrong against our Light and invisible to the player; the printed name must be restored and the broken link dropped.
The feat's note appears nowhere: Black Tentacles is hidden as superseded and Slither, its recorded replacement, carries nothing.
Spew Tentacles has the same defect as Toppling Tentacles: its printed note reaches neither Black Tentacles nor Slither.
The emblem has a one-action activation and a daily use but no spell behind them; the printed once-per-day Thoughtful Gift must be added.
The emblem has no activation cost and no spell; the printed once-per-day Concordant Choir must be added with the spell's own 1-to-3-action cost.
The emblem shows a two-action activation and a once-a-day use but casts nothing; the printed once-per-day Tailwind must be added.
Only the neither-trained branch is built; the two branches the book prints for a character already trained in one or both skills are missing.
The already-trained-in-Crafting case wrongly hands out a free skill of choice on top of Specialty Crafting; print gives the feat only.
Nothing changes: 'either X or Y' is ONE pick, which the app already asks; WG's grant of both spells is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: 'your choice of X or Y' is ONE pick, which the app already asks; WG's grant of both spells is a deliberate difference.
The granted stone armour carries no proficiency at all, so a kineticist's AC is wrong until the player fixes it by hand; the armour must use the wearer's best armour proficiency by itself.
The granted hardwood armour carries no proficiency, only a note telling the player to set it themselves, so the impulse leaves a kineticist worse off than their own armour.
The Enhancement tier is only a note telling the player to work it out; it must be computed, and switched on only by an augmentation feat that names this feat.
The free armour pick offers a non-existent item and grants nothing; it must be a real pick landing in inventory.
The spell collection is built per rank, matching WG rather than print; it must be ONE flat pool sized by the character's total spell slots, with at least one 1st-rank spell.
Only the proficiency half of the daily choice is asked; the printed skill feat half is a note that grants nothing.
Both takings of Dream Magic share one answer, so a player who takes it twice still gets only one spell; print says the second taking gives the spell not chosen the first time.
The immanence gives the benefits of Diehard, but the dying value on the sheet never moves.
Soul Well's one-minute effect raises the dying value permanently; the same toggle shape that fixes Scar of the Survivor fixes it.
The spider instinct's Web attack rides as text on the Rage action because the engine cannot hold an attack that deals no damage; it must become a real attack row.
Nothing changes: the armour's item bonus rises to +4 at 5th and +5 at 10th as printed; WG's flat +3 is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the dedication grants no Focus Point - the pool is printed on Psi Development at 6th, where the app already carries it; WG's dedication-granted pool is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the feat grants Adopted Ancestry outright as printed; WG's hide-the-feat encoding is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the master-Survival +2 raises the initiative bonus - the only thing the printed text calls a circumstance bonus; WG's Perception-only reading is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: expert Legal Lore rising to master at 7th and legendary at 15th, plus the Objection reaction and the +1 note, all as printed; WG's trained-only row is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the feat grants the matching instinct ability and no Hit Points; WG's +3 maximum HP is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the pistol's runes carry over to the reinforced stock as printed; WG's plain base weapon is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the +1 circumstance bonus lands on Thievery as printed; WG's Stealth placement is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: all nine printed Lores are offered and each trains itself; WG's Labor Lore option writing Herbalism Lore is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: all six printed planar lores are offered and each trains the right lore; WG's five-option list is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the fire weakness is one-third level with a minimum of 1, as printed; WG's minimum-less formula is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: a goloma is granted Goloma and Mwangi as printed; WG's Common grant is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the background trains Survival and Cooking Lore and grants Forager, as printed; WG's untrained Survival operation is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the background prints one boost (Constitution or Wisdom) and no free boost; WG's second boost is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: no printing of Haunted names a feat; WG's Recognize Spell grant is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: 'you can choose Arboreal' is permission, and our language picker already offers every language; WG's outright Arboreal grant is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: all three printed Lores are offered and the Harrow the Fiend free action is built; WG's duplicated Daemon Lore is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the background trains Heraldry Lore as printed; WG's misspelled "Heradlry Lore" is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the background offers Strength or Wisdom plus a free boost, uncommon as printed; WG's broken Wisdom option is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the font stays at 9th rank because Miraculous Spell bars 10th-rank slots from slot-granting abilities; WG's 10th-rank font at 19-20 is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the swim Speed of 10 feet and the amphibious trait are unconditional as printed; WG's capping condition is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: void resistance is half your level with a minimum of 1 as printed; WG's minimum-less formula is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: print gives two different numbers (encumbered +1, maximum +2) and the app carries both; WG's single value of 2 is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the reroll follows the chosen skill and the note already sits on that skill's row; WG's Acrobatics-for-everything reroll is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: +1 spirit damage per die, +3 per die against a foe below half Hit Points, as printed; WG's persistent-damage reading with no below-half clause is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the transcendence is A Moment Unending's precision damage as printed; WG's Reactive Strike grant is a different ability wearing the printed name.
Nothing changes: +10 Speed standing and +20 in Overdrive is the printed total, with the legendary +30 shown as a note; WG's rank-free +30 is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: both options grant a focus spell and Stasis carries the focus trait; WG's ordinary-spell Stasis is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the resistance keeps its floor of 1 (a deliberate small step past the literal page, which prints no minimum), and WG's extra resistance against dragons is not copied.
The item shows as a blank priced object; print has no rules body at all, so one plain line clearly marked as ours must say so - and WG's invented +1 to seven skills must never be added.
The Major grade stays at the base 2nd rank for both spells (the archive's Major block never restates the 5th-rank heightening), but its own printed pieces must be present.
The staff ships a once-per-minute limit and a 'per minute' pip that no source prints; the page has no Frequency line at all.
The rest of the staff's printed contents must be verified against the page in the same pass.
Nothing changes: Seasonal Boon stays a free action with no frequency because our page prints none; WG's 'once per season' is a deliberate difference.
The three +1 stars must be scoped to the four named actions and to resisting them, not blanket, and the two-sizes-larger permission must be shown.
Nothing changes on the Bulk aura: WG's 15-foot aura letting allies carry 4 more Bulk is not printed anywhere and is not copied.
Spirit Walk prints no sense clause; its three printed benefits must be present as stars and notes instead.
Nothing changes: WG's precise 30-foot sense comes from a row marked (playtest), which is never evidence about the released record.
The feat carries a live builder-time picker and a dead daily-preparations picker; there must be ONE control, asked at daily preparations.
Same defect as its nagaji twin: the choice must be a single control at daily preparations granting a divine at-will cantrip.
All three spells are granted correctly but the question is asked in the builder and again, uselessly, at daily preparations; one control at daily preparations is what print prints.
Two questions are asked for one decision and only the builder one grants; there must be a single daily-preparations control.
Same defect as the other five kitsune and nagaji spell feats: the choice belongs at daily preparations as a single control.
Same defect as the other five kitsune and nagaji spell feats: the choice belongs at daily preparations as a single control.
Nothing changes: the domain spells use the tradition the character qualified with; WG's divine/Wisdom pin is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the focus spells use the tradition of the character's own spell slots; WG's divine/Intelligence pin is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the feat prints no tradition, so the character's own focus tradition and attribute stand; WG's separate Arcane/Intelligence focus source has no printed basis.
Nothing changes: the dragon eidolon's tradition is printed as Arcane and fixed, with no picker; WG's four-way picker is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the resistance is worked out from the character (3 + half level to void, or vitality with void healing) with no control shown; WG's two pickers are a deliberate difference.
The innate Time Sense cantrip falls back to arcane instead of deriving its tradition the way the archetype's focus spells already do.
Nothing changes: the Speed benefit is a star naming both conditions, not a number; WG's unconditional Speed change is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: darkvision appears only while the Rage toggle is on, as printed; WG's permanent Darkvision is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: the 30-foot dash is a table choice shown as a star, not a flat Speed increase; WG's always-on +5 Speed is a deliberate difference.
Nothing changes: both halves of the penalty apply only in one narrow spot each, so they stay notes rather than numbers on the sheet; WG's sixteen numeric rows are a deliberate difference.
The physical resistance is behind a hand toggle, but the condition (wearing medium or heavy armour) is visible to the sheet, so it must be a real automatic number.
The dedication grants a duplicate copy of both claw Strikes, so each shows twice and the dedication's pair shows even with no stance turned on.
The five-option energy question is asked at 4th level; print holds it back to 8th.
The record is flagged takable twice, but no printed clause allows it.
The feat grants trained advanced weapons forever with no expert step, and wrongly hands over the Weapon Expertise class feature.
The Bespell Strikes extra damage line is missing from the record entirely.
Speed bonuses are added together untyped and only to walking Speed; print types them and a clause saying 'to your Speeds' raises every Speed.
Nothing changes: the ten-spell apparition ladder matches print rung for rung, with Illusory Scene at 5th; WG's rank-1 Illusory Disguise on that rung is their mistake.
The record carries no bonus at all, though its six sibling astrolabes carry the printed star and the item can be used as a mariner's astrolabe.

Three separate pickers for shape, damage and save make illegal breaths buildable and ignore the draconic exemplar the player already chose; all three must be derived from that exemplar using the printed Draconic Benefactors table.
The three printed skill increases are not built at all and the record's note tells the player to apply them by hand, quietly taking WG's both-Lores-each-time reading.
The greater grade still shows the base 30-foot, DC 25 sentence; only its own printed numbers belong on it.
The major grade still shows the base 30-foot, DC 25 sentence; only its own printed numbers belong on it.
The greater wyrm spindle carries the base grade's numbers; only its own printed numbers belong on it.
The major wyrm spindle carries the base grade's numbers; only its own printed numbers belong on it.
Nothing changes: the transcendence keeps its printed name Flowing Spirit Strike; WG's Mirrored Spirit Strike appears nowhere in the archive.
